blocks.content: Recognize ADS-B Out and TCAS purpose.

items.definition: TCAS interrogates nearby aircraft transponders and tracks their position. Issues: Traffic Advisories (TA) for awareness, and Resolution Advisories (RA) with specific vertical maneuver instructions to prevent mid-air collision. TCAS operates independently of ATC.
items.analogy: Like a car's collision avoidance system that warns you and then says 'brake NOW' — it doesn't wait for a traffic light.

items.definition: ADS-B Out broadcasts (1090ES or UAT): GPS position, GPS altitude, pressure altitude, groundspeed, track, identification (ICAO address + flight ID), and other state data. Transmitted automatically and continuously without interrogation. Required in most controlled airspace per 14 CFR 91.225.
items.analogy: Like a ship's AIS transponder — continuously broadcasting who you are, where you are, and how fast you're going to anyone listening.

blocks.question: What does TCAS do?
choices: Displays ATC-assigned squawk codes from other aircraft on the ND
Transmits ADS-B position data to nearby aircraft
Monitors nearby transponder-equipped aircraft and provides RAs to prevent collision
Alerts crew when another aircraft is broadcasting an emergency squawk
blocks.feedback: TCAS interrogates, tracks, computes threat, and advises. TAs warn of traffic; RAs instruct a specific vertical maneuver (climb or descend). TCAS coordinates with the intruder's TCAS (if equipped) to ensure complementary maneuvers — one climbs while the other descends.

blocks.question: What information does ADS-B Out broadcast?
choices: Only squawk code and Mode C altitude identical to a standard transponder
Encrypted flight plan data to ATC ground stations only
GPS position, altitude, velocity, and aircraft identification, plus other state data
TCAS coordination data to nearby aircraft only
blocks.feedback: ADS-B Out is far richer than Mode A/C: it broadcasts GPS-derived position (latitude/longitude), GPS and pressure altitude, groundspeed, track, ICAO address, flight ID, and other state parameters — all unsolicited and continuously. This gives ATC and other aircraft a GPS-precision picture of every equipped aircraft.
